_contract: IDENTITY TEST, the day's last 10 credits: one corrected clip - colour host, fixed prompt, signal box. If he holds through 6s in motion, day two runs; if he drifts, try him as a Flow Character first.
_style: woodblock-vox-newsprint-v2 for the WHOLE frame, host included: he is a detailed illustrated figure in the scene's own register, never 'cartoon', never a silhouette, never a sticker. NO text, lettering, numerals, charts, graphs, axes or screens anywhere in frame - a chart in a generated frame is a fabricated figure.

scenes.prompt: Woodblock newsprint illustration, dusk over a railway signal box, the exact scene of the first reference held as a locked camera. The host - the second reference, drawn exactly as that figure and in the SAME ink-and-newsprint register as the scene, not a different medium pasted on: a detailed illustrated man, textured navy suit with fine cross-hatching, light blue shirt, orange patterned tie, brown belt and brown brogues, black-rimmed glasses, trimmed goatee, hair in tied-up locs, natural adult proportions (no enlarged head), no white outline, no sticker edge, lit by the scene's dusk - steps in from frame left in a calm lateral stride, stops at left-third, and settles into pointing right toward the rails. Stylised, minimal leg articulation; the world keeps its ink-print texture and constant grain, the host keeps his line, texture and colour across the whole clip. The background does not move. No text, no lettering, no numerals, no signs.
